text: enquired: Heb. sought the face, etc.

We will have no silver nor gold of Saul, nor of his house, neither for us shalt thou kill: Or, it is not silver or gold that we have to do with Saul, or his house, neither pertains it to us to kill etc.
devised against us: Or, cut us off
whom the LORD did choose: Or, chosen of the Lord
Michal: Or, Michals sister | brought up for Adriel: Heb. bare to Adriel
the giant: Or, Rapha | spear: He. the staff, or the head
